done.122:
All figures in reports are calculated by code from primary sources, stored in a local
SQLite database, and can be audited. The language model only writes narrative from those figures.
done.142: Public CoinGecko API, top 60 assets, snapshot every 15 minutes. 400-day daily history from Binance klines for assets listed on Binance.
done.154: Binance USD-M Futures: 8-hour funding rate, open interest, account long/short ratio, taker buy/sell ratio. Only three assets (BTC, ETH, SOL) to preserve quota.
done.166: S&P 500 and VIX from CBOE (daily CSV). US Treasury yield curve (2Y, 10Y, 30Y). EUR/USD, USD/JPY, USD/CNY, USD/GBP rates from ECB. Gold uses PAXG from CoinGecko.
done.178: Aggregate stablecoin supply and DeFi TVL from DefiLlama. US spot ETF flows from Farside Investors (read daily). Bitcoin network statistics from Blockchair.
done.190: Fear & Greed Index from Alternative.me, 7- and 30-day averages, plus one-year percentile.
done.202: RSS from CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Blockworks, Decrypt, Federal Reserve, ECB, BIS, and Google News queries for macro, geopolitics, regulation, and ETFs.
done.230: Composite score from VIX, S&P 500 position relative to MA50, 20-day change in UST 10Y, BTC position relative to MA200, and 7-day breadth. Score -3 or lower = risk-off.
done.242: 8-hour funding multiplied by 3 and by 365. Positive means longs pay shorts, a sign that long positioning is crowded.
done.254: Current value's position within the last 365-day range. 90 means the current value is higher than 90% of days in the year.
done.266: Number of assets with positive 7-day change, and number of assets above MA50 from the sample with sufficient history.
done.278: Distance of current price from the 400-day peak, in negative percent.
done.290: Editorial assessment of evidence quality: high when there are many independent sources and long data history, low when it relies on a single series or short sample.
done.310: ETF data is available only for trading days and has been collected since October 2026, so long-term flow analysis is not yet possible.
done.314: Derivatives are only from Binance, not an aggregate across all exchanges. Positions on other exchanges are not visible.
done.318: CoinGecko rate-limits requests from VPS IPs. When the limit is hit, the collector uses the last cache and notes it in the log.
done.322: Report narratives are composed by a language model from numbers calculated by code. The model never invents numbers, but emphasis and interpretation can be wrong and should be read critically.
done.326: There is no institutional positioning data (13F), paid on-chain exchange reserve data, or options data at strike level. Positioning analysis is therefore incomplete.
done.342:
